verdict.rationale: doola lets Partner Portal users create, revoke and delete multiple API keys, so a distinct revocable key can be issued per agent. Sandbox keys are a coarse privilege boundary because they never trigger real filings or charges. There is no evidence of per-key scopes, resource-level permissions, or read-only/limited-action keys for production. missing for 10: per-key permission scopes, least-privilege restriction on live keys, key expiry/rotation policies, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can issue scoped/least-privilege API credentials for an agent

citations.quote: signed-in Partner Portal users create, revoke and delete keys themselves, and you can hold several at once.
Sandbox keys never trigger real state filings or charges.
